ITEM 2 | Dark brown chunks of cooked meat with a glossy, slightly sticky surface and browned, seared edges, roughly 3 cm pieces, three to four pieces clustered on the left side of the plate | 90
ITEM 3 | Pale yellow-green shredded leafy vegetable, crisp-looking strips with a creamy, glossy coating, mixed with small grey-brown bits and pale pieces, piled loosely in the upper right of the plate, about 10 cm across and 2 cm high | 75
ITEM 4 | Rectangular slice of baked dish with a pale crust base, topped with red-orange sauce and melted cheese showing golden-brown blistered spots and patches, about 8 cm by 5 cm and 2 cm thick, sitting at the bottom center of the plate | 120
ITEM 5 | Creamy pale dressing coating the shredded greens, appearing thick and matte-white with light yellow tint, spread across the leaves in the upper right area | 15
